raw_requirements: Right now leads pour in from trade shows, our website, social media, referrals, and outbound calls, but spreadsheets are killing our follow-up speed.
Any quote with a discount above 15 % needs my sign-off, so I’d like an automated approval step for that.
Every new opportunity should auto-create two tasks: send a sample pack within three days and schedule a pricing call within ten.
Please be sure email replies log back to Salesforce so we can keep response times under 24 hours.
